Subject: Finalize Q3 commit roster + escrow confirmation

Emma — following up from our call yesterday. We need to lock the commit roster for Q3 so finance can recognize the backlog before close. Quick summary of where we stand: 

- Committed ARR under legal review: $420k (2 deals)
- Verbal commit, awaiting PO: $260k (1 deal)
- Probable (>=80%): $160k (3 deals)

Action items I need from Acme by EOD Tue (48 hours):
1) Confirm which orders will be PO'd vs. requiring escrow (you mentioned one deal needs escrow).
2) Provide PO numbers to procurement@acme.io (cc'd) or share the DocuSign escrow envelope link.
3) Any contract redlines that would move a deal out of commit.

Attached is the latest commit_roster_v3.xlsx (owners + stages). I will run a final rollup on Wed morning and send the PDF to finance for booking.

If procurement is sending PO, please copy David (finance) so we can match quickly.

Thanks — let's keep this tight.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, GTM Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_roster_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — N
